focusTitle.en: Research on Deep Learning Methods for Wafer Map Defect Pattern Analysis under Limited and Evolving Data Scenarios
focusTitle.zh: 面向少样本与动态晶圆图数据的缺陷模式深度学习分析方法研究

description.en: This thesis builds an automated wafer map inspection pipeline for semiconductor manufacturing under limited labels and evolving defect distributions. It integrates unsupervised pixel-level anomaly detection, semi-supervised defect segmentation, zero-shot defect pattern retrieval, and exemplar-free class-incremental learning to support accurate detection, fine-grained localization, scalable retrieval of unseen defects, and continual recognition as new defect types emerge—while respecting practical constraints such as data retention and memory limits.
description.zh: 本论文针对半导体制造中的晶圆图检测任务，构建了一个面向少样本与动态缺陷分布的自动化检测流程。该流程集成了无监督像素级异常检测、半监督缺陷分割、零样本缺陷模式检索和无样本增量学习等模块，实现了准确检测、细粒度定位、可扩展的未知缺陷检索及新缺陷类型的持续识别，同时兼顾数据保留和内存限制等实际约束。

institution.en: BEIJING UNIVERSITY OF POSTS AND TELECOMMUNICATIONS

focusTitle.en: Research and Implementation of the Costume Generation for Scratch. 3.0
focusTitle.zh: 基于Scratch 3.0的服装生成研究与实现

description.en: This project integrates Scratch 3.0 with deep learning–based image translation to help students turn hand-drawn sketches into usable sprites and then apply cartoon-style rendering. It includes a sketch-to-image model with a lightweight MultiResU-Net–based generator to reduce artifacts and training cost, a Dense-CartoonGAN for end-to-end cartoonization with fewer parameters, and a Scratch-side application that connects both functions into an interactive workflow.
description.zh: 本项目将Scratch 3.0与基于深度学习的图像转换技术相结合，帮助学生将手绘草图转换为可用的角色形象，并应用卡通风格渲染。项目包括一个基于轻量级MultiResU-Net生成器的草图到图像模型，以减少伪影和训练成本；一个参数更少的Dense-CartoonGAN，用于端到端的卡通化处理；以及一个Scratch端应用，将两种功能连接成一个交互式工作流程。
